In Sep, I joined one SR-RA on telegram premium group seeing his month end publication of target achieved during entire month, mentioned 2 stop loss during aug trades.

I took subscription thinking he will give one trade a day but full proof mostly.. 2 stoploss/ 22 trading days. 

I was newbie so didn’t knowing risk management is a thing and I should be cautious to protect my capital too.

He follows very formal template. 
No reasoning given, why we are taking that trade.. just levels with 4 targets and a huge stoploss. Risk/Reward for 1st target mostly 1/ 0.5

What accuracy they claim, I don’t get..? Suppose He give buy call @70 and stoploss 20. After buying entire day it was moving around 45-55. 

No guidance during the trade. 

once came to 15 then real move started to target 90.  Now will boast as target achieved. Mentioning: low went to 15 but did not sustain 30 min candle. WTF!!

I did earn 5k few days but lost 40k 70k on odd days. My mistake was I was blindly trusting his levels and to recover losses I increased my position sizing. Lost almost 1.5L in a month. 

Sad part is now I am learning and understanding the market after wiping out my capital.

but here I have to say about you that seeing so much loss still amazed by your skill of  stock option trading. Many trade you gave in group that make me think that how you would have predicted that..Definitely some reasoning would have been there but I consider you a magician.
